verdict.rationale: Undermind is an AI research service that handles user queries and uploaded files, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence of a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. The only related item is an enterprise data-removal request, which is deletion rather than training prevention and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
